commit_message:
fix(company): match the peviitor company by exact name instead of taking the first result

Propagated from the Brewtality-3-16 template (commit 79c899c). api.peviitor.ro/v1/company/?name= does not filter server-side, so taking companies[0] could return an unrelated company and label this scraper's jobs with its name. The scraper now keeps only a case-insensitive exact name match and falls back to the ANAF name when nothing matches.

changes.requires_text: return companies[0] if companies else None
